comparison_limit: This is a new 2,048-grid sample. It makes no claim that its slowest ordinal matches any ordinal from the earlier 100,000-grid run.

instrumentation.durability_and_budget: frozen runner policy is unchanged: WAL/FULL and the runner-derived 2,048-record budget; no timed checkpoint added
instrumentation.journal_method: wrapper delegates exactly once to the saved original method and returns its exact result; raised exceptions are re-raised
instrumentation.residual_measurement: method total minus summed SQL execute time; combines Python, lock wait, fetch/decode, serialization, and observer overhead
instrumentation.sql_measurement: time spent inside each SQLite execute/executemany call while record_grid_decision is active
instrumentation.sqlite_observation: Connection/Cursor execute and executemany delegate to sqlite3 originals; SQL text and bound values are not emitted
instrumentation.wrapper_overhead: per-call and per-statement Python dispatch/timer/accounting adds overhead and can materially affect absolute latency; diagnostic only
